summary: A large, sharply marginated lucent area in the right lower hemithorax on prior is no longer seen on current.

findings.rationale: Prior shows a well-defined rounded lucency devoid of lung markings in the right lower lateral chest suggestive of a large pneumothorax (or bulla); this region shows normal lung/soft-tissue density on current, consistent with resolution, though a large bulla cannot be excluded from pixels alone.
